assessments.summary: The argument establishes the claim. Using the referenced receiver-skew midpoint identity and exact total-correlation residual, any two-letter Marton value strictly above 2M_T forces a strictly positive residual for each of the four constant-padding choices. The residual specializes to A_a+B_b−1{a≠b}D−C, yielding all four strict necessary inequalities. Adding the crossed inequalities and applying the stated chain-rule identities gives README equation (12). The padding constructions apply to arbitrary finite two-letter auxiliaries, including the half-skew BSSC, without assuming tuple structure.
scopeQualifications: The inequalities are necessary only; they do not prove additivity, exhibit a gaining law, establish sufficiency, or determine capacity.
The summed crossed condition is weaker than retaining the two crossed inequalities separately.
The result concerns finite receiver-skew broadcast channels and finite auxiliary alphabets.
Numerical checker attestations are corroborative only; the universal conclusion rests on the analytic entropy identities.
